Container.Name: Director-Studio
Container.Overview: Local-first pre-production UI for Unraid. Planning LLM is your existing Ollama container; image and video jobs go to your existing ComfyUI. This container is an orchestrator only and does not need a GPU.
Container.Description:
Director Studio talks to ComfyUI (default http://127.0.0.1:8188) and Ollama (default http://127.0.0.1:11434) over host networking. Do not switch to bridge unless you also change DS_COMFY_BASE_URL and DS_OLLAMA_BASE_URL.
Install ComfyUI and Ollama first. Pick the Director model in the WebUI after start. Set DS_VRAM_POLICY to shared if ComfyUI and Ollama use different GPUs; exclusive if they share one card.
This container does not include models. Point DS_DIRECTOR_VISION_MODEL at an Ollama tag that can inspect images if you use Picture review.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: comfyui ollama filmmaking h3 minimax director storyboard
Container.Requires: Running ComfyUI (typically port 8188) and Ollama (typically port 11434) on the Unraid host. Host network recommended.
Container.Changes: Image published to Docker Hub as calbabyjr/director-studio:latest.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host-network WebUI port. Must match DS_PORT.

Config.Name: DS_HOST
Config.Description: Listen address. Keep 0.0.0.0 for LAN access.

Config.Name: DS_COMFY_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Existing ComfyUI URL as seen from the Unraid host.

Config.Name: DS_OLLAMA_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Existing Ollama URL as seen from the Unraid host.

Config.Name: DS_DIRECTOR_VISION_MODEL
Config.Description: Optional Ollama tag for Picture inspection. Leave empty to auto-pick a VL model.

Config.Name: DS_DIRECTOR_NUM_CTX
Config.Description: Ollama context length for Director chat.

Config.Name: DS_H3_PROVIDER
Config.Description: local = ComfyUI H3. minimax = official MiniMax API.

Config.Name: DS_VRAM_POLICY
Config.Description: shared keeps Comfy and Ollama loaded (use when they are on different GPUs). exclusive unloads the LLM before Comfy jobs.

Config.Name: DS_LLM_KEEP_LOADED
Config.Description: Keep the Director LLM loaded between chat turns.
